verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline as the dominant element and the stacked headline / window / details order reads well, but the alignment is mixed: the headline is flush left, the window is centred and the details are flush right. The headline also runs almost to the right edge and there is a dead band at the bottom. In B the stained-glass window swells to dominate the canvas and pushes the headline into a small, cramped top strip sitting tight against the arch. The date and address are shrunk to tiny, weak text at the bottom with an awkward ragged indent on the date line, so the hierarchy is inverted.
